tasks.short: Compile database rows into a requested map.

steps.what: Identify the database rows the request names.
Compile information to create the requested maps.
Check the map still covers the request.
Store the map the technician accepted.

tasks.design: A request that names layers is identified on {DATA_PLATFORM}, and those rows are compiled into the map. The technician checks that the map covers the request. {OPS_SYSTEM} stores only the accepted map. A request written as prose, with no layer names, is not compiled.
tasks.previous_blocker: Maps were assembled by turning layers on from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Named layers can be compiled. Whether the map answers the request cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A request that names the wrong layer, or an area the database does not cover, stays a check.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which layer the requester actually meant.

ambition.what: A named-layer request can be compiled the same day, and a prose request is returned uncompiled.

tasks.altitude: The compile takes less assembly. The check stays. A prose request does not become a map.

reach.task: Hand over only the accepted map
reach.learn: Which layer the request did not name

evidence.claim: Compiling named rows into a map is a query. The source pack names map stores that draw a layer on request. This is the pattern, not a measured case here.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician compiles and checks. Collecting the data is a different task.
Structured input: request id, layer name, area id. Producer is the requester for the names and the database for the rows. A request with no layer name stops.
The check is remaining time. No layer is added to force a match.
unknowns: Do map requests name layers today?
Who may add a layer the request did not name?
research_questions: How often is a map rebuilt because the wrong layer was left on?

already_counted.description: Checking the map against the request is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire compiled maps when the request is withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: map the technician accepted for that request

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the request is prose, nothing is compiled and the technician still reads it. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor map updates for accuracy and compliance.

steps.what: List changed information since the last update.
Monitor mapping work and the updating of maps.
Decide accuracy and compliance with rules and regulations.
Record the inclusion decision for that map.

tasks.design: Changed information since the last map version is listed on {OPS_SYSTEM}. Monitoring the mapping work and the update stays the technician's. Accuracy, inclusion and compliance with rules and regulations are a decision. The record is that decision. A list of edits is not a compliance finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Updates were noticed when someone compared two paper sheets.
tasks.enabler_now: A list of changed objects is a query. Whether the update complies is not.
tasks.still_hard: A change that is present and still wrong, or a rule that does not fit the map, stays a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which rule the edit has broken.

ambition.what: Map updates are looked at when they land, and a missed inclusion is visible before issue.

tasks.altitude: Finding the edits takes less comparing. Monitoring and the compliance decision stay.

reach.task: See updates that were not accepted

evidence.claim: Listing changed objects between two map versions is a query. A compliance decision is not.
Map rules differ by place. The source pack does not name a statute that this record would satisfy. The decision is the technician's note.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician monitors and decides. Issuing the map is a different task.
Structured input: map id, version, changed object id, decision. Producer is the map store for the changes and the technician for the decision. A decision with no map id is refused.
Monitoring time stays. The record does not mark a map compliant by itself.
unknowns: Is there a written rule set for these maps?
research_questions: How often does an update go out without the new information?

already_counted.description: Monitoring the update is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire decision records when the map version is superseded.

approvals.approved_version: compliance decision the technician made for that version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If versions are not stored, the change list is empty and the technician still monitors the sheets. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write source and method notes for land parcels.

steps.what: Complete detailed source and method notes.
Notes describing location of routine or complex parcels.
Attach the notes to the parcel record.

tasks.design: Source and method notes, and the description of where routine or complex parcels sit, stay writing the technician does. {DATA_PLATFORM} only attaches the finished note to the parcel. A note is not generated from the coordinates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes were a paragraph at the end of the field book and were not on the parcel.
tasks.enabler_now: Attaching a file to a parcel id is a link. Writing the method is not.
tasks.still_hard: A complex parcel, or a method that the standard note does not cover, stays writing.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which source the location actually came from.
tasks.altitude: Finding the note later takes less hunting. Writing it stays.

reach.task: Read the method with the parcel

evidence.claim: Linking a note to a parcel id is a file. Writing the method note is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician writes the notes. Determining the boundary is a different task.
Structured input: parcel id, source id, method name, note text. Producer is the technician. A note with no parcel id is not attached.
Writing time stays. The link does not rewrite the note.
unknowns: Where do method notes live today?
research_questions: How often is the method known only to the person who surveyed?

already_counted.description: Writing the source notes is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire notes when the parcel record is superseded.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If parcels are not indexed, the note is still written and attached later. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hold rods and targets for theodolite sighting.

steps.what: Position and hold the vertical rods or targets.
Hold the sighting so operators can measure.
Book angles, distances and elevations they called.

tasks.design: Positioning and holding the vertical rod or target stays in the field, for the theodolite operators' sighting. Angles, distances and elevations are booked only as the operators call them. Nothing holds the rod except the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: The rod was held, and the station was written in a book that sometimes missed a call.
tasks.enabler_now: A called figure can be a field. Holding the rod plumb cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Wind, a soft point, or a call the technician did not hear, stays the hold and a query.
tasks.human_edge: The technician feels the rod leave plumb before the shot is stored.
tasks.altitude: Booking a repeated station takes a little less rewriting. Holding the rod and the sighting stay.

reach.task: Use the booked station with the shots

evidence.claim: A station line in a book is a note. Holding a rod for a sighting is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician holds the rod and books the call. Operating the theodolite is the operator's task, not this one.
Structured input: station id, angle, distance, elevation, as called. Producer is the operator's call and the technician's booking. A figure that was not called is not booked.
The hold stays. The book does not invent a call.
unknowns: Does the collector already store the shot the operator takes?
Who repeats a call that was missed?
research_questions: How often is a station rebooked because the first figure was misheard?

already_counted.description: Holding the rod is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire booked stations when the job is re-observed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If calls are not written down, the hold is unchanged and the operator's own store is the record. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Requested maps compile only from named rows, and the technician still checks the request. Monitoring an update and writing parcel notes stay. Holding a rod stays in the field.
reach: The party chief receives a map only after the check.
Parcel notes sit on the parcel, not only in the book.
skills_to_grow: Book only the figure the operator called.
role.ambitious_version: A map update is looked at when it lands, and a stake list shows the plan calls that had no coordinate.
